info.name: CooBS Platform — End-to-End Master Test Suite (11 Services)
info.description:
Comprehensive End-to-End integration test suite for the CooBS 11-microservice platform.
Covers Ingress Gateway, Authentication, Customer 360, Account Management, 11-Stage Distributed Transfer Saga, Reversal & Compensation Saga (FIN-104), Double-Entry Ledgering, In-App Notifications, and SHA-256 Cryptographic Audit Chain.

Designed to run using 'CooBS Local Environment' (postman/CooBS_Local.postman_environment.json) or in CI via Newman.
